supersession_rule: For Chapter 2 manuscript claims, this file supersedes older active_development_mainline fields that label v12 initial-position heterogeneity as a replicated minimal generator. It does not alter the broader comparative programme or its empirical admission gates.

five_questions: Can the same broad interaction reorganization generate opposite biological responses?
What controls response sign and branch identity?
Does real island ecology require a vocabulary richer than a single syndrome?
Can existing island studies distinguish the mechanisms implied by that architecture?
What becomes distinguishable when resolution increases in Izu?

primary_question: Why can the same community reorganization produce different biological response signs, what information identifies branch identity, and which components become distinguishable when empirical resolution increases?

interaction_kernel.rejected_shortcut: K_I(x0) - K_M(x0) when environment-specific trait adjustment changes final plant states
interaction_kernel.aggregation_boundary: per-realization sign equivalence does not replace the nonlinear mean service contrast with a difference of mean kernels

primary_model_result.interpretation: starting functional position organizes the mean sign boundary but does not determine cell-level response alone; realized community state and state-by-community non-additivity are part of the active explanation

joint_robustness.interpretation: mixed geometry occupies a substantial declared design region but is not universal; coexistence of mixed and one-direction regimes is part of the result; design-space frequencies are not ecological prevalence

conditional_why_diagnostics.interpretation: partner turnover accompanies regime movement; starting position organizes mean geometry; realized community dominates cell-level variation and combines non-additively with starting position; driver coefficients are fixed-design associations rather than causal effects

how_why_scope.proximal_why: model-conditional turnover-dependent regime plus starting-state-by-realized-community contingency and asymmetric local branch allocation
how_why_scope.ultimate_why: not tested; assembly colonization persistence and evolutionary history remain outside the simulation

raw_matching_projection.interpretation: source floral starting state plus broad community composition organizes realized raw trait matching

structural_audit.interpretation: empirical support is at source-state and background-community-composition level, not non-random partner sorting beyond composition

chapter3_handoff: measure source state, community assembly, realized sorting, effectiveness and reproductive propagation on comparable focal units; Chapter 3 is a next measurement stage and is not Chapter 2 validation, Bombus causation, pollinator-selection proof or external prediction success
next_manuscript_gate: validate the five-question funnel, exact interaction-kernel identity, redesigned figures, supporting-information role separation and unchanged frozen numerical results; retain external-prediction not_evaluable and the Izu null-corrected negative result
